@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+"""Service layer for maintenance windows."""
+
+from datetime import date
+
+from app.clock import Clock
+from app.errors import ConflictError, InvalidRequestError
+from app.models import Item, MaintenanceWindow, MaintenanceWindowCreate
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def create_maintenance_window(
+    store: Store, item_id: int, data: MaintenanceWindowCreate, clock: Clock
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Create a new maintenance window for an item."""
+    validate_range(data.start, data.end)
+
+    # Check for overlap with active reservations
+    # Note: ensure_available is used here to check for conflicts with reservations.
+    # We are not checking for conflicts between maintenance windows themselves, as per requirements.
+    item = store.items.get(item_id) # Assuming get_item is available or we fetch it here
+    if item is None:
+        raise InvalidRequestError(f"Item {item_id} not found") # Or NotFoundError
+
+    # We need to ensure that the maintenance window does not overlap with any *active* reservations.
+    # The ensure_available function checks this.
+    # However, ensure_available raises ConflictError if there's an overlap. We need to catch this.
+    try:
+        # We pass a dummy date range for ensure_available as it's only checking for reservation conflicts here.
+        # The actual date range is data.start and data.end.
+        # A more robust solution would be to have a dedicated function for checking reservation conflicts.
+        from app.services.availability import find_reservation_conflicts
+        reservation_conflicts = find_reservation_conflicts(store, item_id, data.start, data.end)
+        if reservation_conflicts:
+            raise ConflictError("Maintenance window overlaps with an active reservation")
+
+    except ConflictError as e:
+        raise ConflictError(str(e)) # Re-raise the conflict error
+
+    # Generate a unique ID for the maintenance window
+    window_id = store.maintenance_windows.allocate_id()
+
+    # Create the MaintenanceWindow object
+    maintenance_window = MaintenanceWindow(
+        id=window_id,
+        item_id=item_id,
+        start=data.start,
+        end=data.end,
+    )
+
+    # Store the new maintenance window
+    store.maintenance_windows.insert(maintenance_window)
+
+    return maintenance_window
+
+def list_maintenance_windows(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """List all maintenance windows for an item."""
+    # Fetch all maintenance windows and filter by item_id
+    all_windows = store.maintenance_windows.all()
+    item_windows = [w for w in all_windows if w.item_id == item_id]
+    # Order by start date, then by id
+    item_windows.sort(key=lambda w: (w.start, w.id))
+    return item_windows
+
+def validate_range(start: date, end: date) -> None:
+    """Reject empty or inverted date ranges."""
+    if end <= start:
+        raise InvalidRequestError("end must be after start")

+  1| # Rentwise
+  2| 
+  3| Rentwise is the back-office API of a small equipment rental shop: power tools, camping gear,
+  4| photo equipment and garden machines. It is a FastAPI service with in-memory storage, seeded
+  5| with demo data on start-up.
+  6| 
+  7| This README is the **specification**. Where the code and this document disagree, the code
+  8| is wrong.
+  9| 
+ 10| ## Running
+ 11| 
+ 12| ```sh
+ 13| pytest -q          # tests
+ 14| ruff check .       # lint
+ 15| ```
+ 16| 
+ 17| `app.main:create_app(store=None, clock=None)` builds an application. By default it uses a
+ 18| freshly seeded `Store` and the system clock; tests inject a `FixedClock` pinned to
+ 19| 2025-06-02 (`app.seed.SEED_TODAY`).
+ 20| 
+ 21| ## Layout
+ 22| 
+ 23| | Path | Purpose |
+ 24| | --- | --- |
+ 25| | `app/models.py` | Pydantic models and enums |
+ 26| | `app/storage.py` | In-memory repositories, `Store`, seed loader |
+ 27| | `app/seed.py` | Demo data |
+ 28| | `app/clock.py` | Injectable "today" |
+ 29| | `app/errors.py` | Domain exceptions -> HTTP errors |
+ 30| | `app/services/` | Business rules (catalog, customers, availability, pricing, reservations, returns, invoices, reports) |
+ 31| | `app/daterange.py` | Value object for half-open date ranges |
+ 32| | `app/api/routes.py` | All HTTP routes |
+ 33| 
+ 34| ## Domain rules
+ 35| 
+ 36| ### Dates
+ 37| 
+ 38| All date ranges are **half-open** `[start, end)`. A reservation's `end` is exclusive: the
+ 39| item is back in the shop on the morning of `end`. So a reservation ending on day X and
+ 40| another starting on day X for the same item do **not** overlap and are both allowed.
+ 41| The number of rental days is `end - start`.
+ 42| 
+ 43| ### Items
+ 44| 
+ 45| An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and
+ 46| `status`: `available`, `maintenance` or `retired`.
+ 47| 
+ 48| - Only `available` items can be reserved.
+ 49| - Retiring an item is permanent; a retired item cannot change status again.
+ 50| - New items must reference an existing category; `daily_rate` must be positive.
+ 51| 
+ 52| ### Catalog search
+ 53| 
+ 54| `GET /items` lists items ordered by id.
+ 55| 
+ 56| - `q`: case-insensitive substring match on the item name (`"tent"` finds
+ 57|   "Two-Person Tent" and "Family Tent").
+ 58| - `category`: exact category id.
+ 59| - Pagination: first skip `offset` matching items, then return at most `limit` items
+ 60|   (`limit` 1..100, default 20; `offset` >= 0, default 0). `total` is the number of
+ 61|   matching items before pagination.
+ 62| 
+ 63| ### Customers
+ 64| 
+ 65| A customer has `id`, `name`, `email` (unique, case-insensitive, stored lower-case) and
+ 66| `tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.
+ 67| 
+ 68| ### Reservations
+ 69| 
+ 70| A reservation has `item_id`, `customer_id`, `start`, `end`, optional `coupon_code` and
+ 71| `status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.
+ 72| 
+ 73| - `end` must be after `start`; a reservation may last at most 90 days.
+ 74| - `start` may not be in the past (today is allowed).
+ 75| - The item and customer must exist; an unknown coupon code is rejected (422).
+ 76| - The item must be `available`.
+ 77| - **An item cannot have overlapping active reservations.** Two ranges overlap when they
+ 78|   share at least one day, i.e. `a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end`. This includes a new
+ 79|   range that starts inside, ends inside, exactly matches, or fully contains an existing one.
+ 80| - **Only `active` reservations block an item.** Cancelled and returned reservations never
+ 81|   affect availability.
+ 82| - Only `active` reservations can be cancelled or returned.
+ 83| 
+ 84| `GET /availability?item_id&start&end` answers whether a reservation for that range would be
+ 85| accepted, with a reason and the ids of the conflicting reservations.
+ 86| 
+ 87| ### Pricing
+ 88| 
+ 89| - `days = end - start`. One day is free for every **full** 7 days:
+ 90|   `billable_days = days - days // 7` (7 days -> 6 billable, 14 -> 12).
+ 91| - Rental amount = `daily_rate * billable_days`.
+ 92| - Tier discount: regular 0%, silver 5%, gold 15%.
+ 93| - Coupons (`POST /coupons`): an upper-case alphanumeric code with a percent off (1..100).
+ 94| - Tier and coupon discounts **add up** (silver 5% + 10% coupon = 15%) and the combined
+ 95|   discount is **capped at 30%** (gold 15% + 20% coupon = 30%, not 35%).
+ 96| - Discounts apply **only to the rental amount** and are applied **before tax**.
+ 97| - Tax is 20% of the discounted subtotal.
+ 98| 
+ 99| ### Returns
+100| 
+101| `POST /reservations/{id}/return` with optional `returned_on` (defaults to today) and
+102| `damaged` flag.
+103| 
+104| - `returned_on` cannot be before `start` or after today.
+105| - `late_days = max(0, returned_on - end)`. Returning on the `end` date (or earlier) is on
+106|   time: 0 late days. Returning on `end + 1` is 1 late day.
+107| - Late fee = `daily_rate * 1.5 * late_days`.
+108| - Damaged: the whole deposit is withheld and the item goes to `maintenance`. Otherwise the
+109|   deposit is refunded in full.
+110| - Early returns are not refunded: the rental is charged for the booked range.
+111| 
+112| ### Invoices
+113| 
+114| `GET /reservations/{id}/invoice` (active or returned reservations; cancelled ones have no
+115| invoice, 409).
+116| 
+117| - Lines: a `rental` line (quantity = billable days) and, for late returns, a `late_fee`
+118|   line (quantity = late days).
+119| - `subtotal` = sum of line amounts.
+120| - `discount` = rental line amount * combined discount rate (tier + coupon, capped at 30%).
+121| - `tax` = 20% of `subtotal - discount`.
+122| - `total` = `subtotal - discount + tax`.
+123| - Money is a decimal, rounded to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP only when a figure is produced
+124|   (each line amount, discount, tax, total) - never on intermediate rates.
+125| 
+126| Example: gold customer, Family Tent (35.00/day), 5 days: subtotal 175.00, discount 26.25,
+127| tax 29.75, total 178.50.
+128| 
+129| ### Reports
+130| 
+131| - `GET /reports/revenue?start&end`: net revenue (invoice total minus tax) per category for
+132|   reservations whose `start` falls in `[start, end)`. **Cancelled reservations are
+133|   excluded**; active and returned ones count.
+134| - `GET /reports/utilization?start&end`: for every non-retired item, the number of days in
+135|   `[start, end)` covered by active or returned reservations and that as a percentage of the
+136|   period (one decimal, half up). Cancelled reservations do not count.

+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import date
+
+
+class InvalidRangeError(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DateRange:
+    start: date
+    end: date
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if not self.start < self.end:
+            raise InvalidRangeError("end must be after start")
+
+    @property
+    def days(self) -> int:
+        return (self.end - self.start).days
+
+    def contains(self, day: date) -> bool:
+        return self.start <= day < self.end
+
+    def overlaps(self, other: "DateRange") -> bool:
+        return self.start < other.end and other.start < self.end
+
+    def overlap_days(self, other: "DateRange") -> int:
+        if not self.overlaps(other):
+            return 0
+        return (
+            min(self.end, other.end) - max(self.start, other.start)
+        ).days

-

-

-
-An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and
-`status`: `available`, `maintenance` or `retired`.

-  (`limit` 1..100, default 20; `offset` >= 0, default 0). `total` is the number of

-

-`tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.

-`status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.

-  range that starts inside, ends inside, exactly matches, or fully contains an existing one.

-  affect availability.

+import pytest
+from datetime import date, timedelta
+
+from app.models import Reservation, ReservationStatus

+
+
+pytest_plugins = "tests.fixtures.store"
+
+
+# --- success cases -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_success(store, clock):
+    """Extend an active reservation and verify the new end date."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)  # An active reservation
+    assert reservation.end == date(2025, 6, 4)
+
+    new_end = date(2025, 6, 11)
+    extended_reservation = store.reservations.extend_reservation(
+        store, reservation.id, new_end
+    )
+
+    assert extended_reservation.id == reservation.id
+    assert extended_reservation.end == new_end
+    assert extended_reservation.start == reservation.start
+    assert extended_reservation.item_id == reservation.item_id
+    assert extended_reservation.customer_id == reservation.customer_id
+    assert extended_reservation.status == ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
+
+    # Verify GET /reservations/{id} reflects the change
+    fetched_reservation = store.reservations.get(reservation.id)
+    assert fetched_reservation.end == new_end
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_to_next_booking_start(store, clock):
+    """Extend reservation to exactly the start of the next booking."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)  # Ends 2025-06-04
+    # Another reservation for the same item starts 2025-06-04
+    next_reservation_start = date(2025, 6, 4)
+
+    extended_reservation = store.reservations.extend_reservation(
+        store, reservation.id, next_reservation_start
+    )
+    assert extended_reservation.end == next_reservation_start
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_ignores_cancelled_overlap(store, clock):
+    """Extending should ignore cancelled reservations in the overlap check."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)  # Ends 2025-06-04
+    # Reservation 6 is cancelled and overlaps the extension period
+    cancelled_overlap_end = date(2025, 6, 7)
+
+    extended_reservation = store.reservations.extend_reservation(
+        store, reservation.id, cancelled_overlap_end
+    )
+    assert extended_reservation.end == cancelled_overlap_end
+
+
+# --- error cases -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_not_found(store):
+    """Extending a non-existent reservation should raise NotFoundError."""
+    with pytest.raises(NotFoundError):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, 999, date(2025, 6, 10))
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_not_active(store):
+    """Extending a non-active reservation should raise ConflictError."""
+    # Reservation 1 is returned
+    with pytest.raises(ConflictError, match=".*returned.*"):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, 1, date(2025, 6, 10))
+
+    # Reservation 3 is cancelled
+    with pytest.raises(ConflictError, match=".*cancelled.*"):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, 3, date(2025, 6, 10))
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_new_end_not_strictly_after(store):
+    """New end date must be strictly after current end date."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)
+    # New end date is the same as current end date
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidRequestError, match=".*strictly after.*"):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, reservation.id, reservation.end)
+
+    # New end date is before current end date
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidRequestError, match=".*strictly after.*"):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, reservation.id, reservation.end - timedelta(days=1))
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_exceeds_max_days(store, clock):
+    """Extending reservation to exceed MAX_RENTAL_DAYS should raise InvalidRequestError."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)
+    # Current days: (2025-06-04 - 2025-06-01) = 3 days
+    # MAX_RENTAL_DAYS = 90
+    # New end date to make total days 91
+    new_end = reservation.start + timedelta(days=MAX_RENTAL_DAYS + 1)
+
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidRequestError, match=f".*{MAX_RENTAL_DAYS} days total"):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, reservation.id, new_end)
+
+    # Verify reservation is unchanged
+    fetched_reservation = store.reservations.get(reservation.id)
+    assert fetched_reservation.end == date(2025, 6, 4)
+
+

+    """Extending to overlap with another active reservation should raise ConflictError."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)  # Ends 2025-06-04
+    # Reservation 4 is active and overlaps the extension period
+    # Item 2 has reservations: 2 (2025-06-01..06-04), 4 (2025-06-05..06-08)
+    # Extending reservation 2 to 2025-06-09 would overlap with reservation 4
+    overlap_end = date(2025, 6, 9)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ConflictError, match=".*conflicts with active reservation.*"):
+        store.reservations.extend_reservation(store, reservation.id, overlap_end)
+
+    # Verify reservation is unchanged

+
+

+    """Missing end in request body should result in 422 validation error."""
+    response = client.post("/reservations/2/extend", json={})
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_malformed_end_body(client):
+    """Malformed end in request body should result in 422 validation error."""
+    response = client.post("/reservations/2/extend", json={"end": "not-a-date"})
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_invoice_reflects_change(store, clock):
+    """Invoice should reflect the extended reservation dates."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(4)  # Circular saw, 2025-06-01..06-04 (3 days)
+    assert reservation.start == date(2025, 1, 1)
+    assert reservation.end == date(2025, 1, 4)
+
+    new_end = date(2025, 1, 11)  # Extends to 10 days total
+    extended_reservation = store.reservations.extend_reservation(
+        store, reservation.id, new_end
+    )
+
+    # Fetch invoice for the extended reservation
+    invoice = store.invoices.get_by_reservation_id(reservation.id)
+
+    # The original reservation was 3 days. Extended to 10 days.
+    # The free day is at 7 days. So, 10 days means 3 billable days.

+    # The total amount should remain the same because the number of billable days (3) is the same.

+    # Extended: 3 days * 10.00 = 30.00
+    # The total amount should remain the same because the number of billable days (3) is the same.

+
+
+def test_extend_reservation_invoice_reflects_change_crossing_free_day(store, clock):
+    """Invoice should reflect extended reservation dates when crossing the free day boundary."""
+    reservation = store.reservations.get(2)  # Ends 2025-06-04 (3 days)

+"""Service functions for maintenance windows."""
+
+from datetime import date
+
+from app.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError
+from app.models import ItemStatus, MaintenanceWindow, MaintenanceWindowCreate
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def schedule_window(
+    store: Store,
+    item_id: int,
+    window_data: MaintenanceWindowCreate,
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Schedule a new maintenance window for an item."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    # Check for overlap with active reservations
+    for reservation in store.reservations.for_item(item_id):
+        if reservation.status == ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and (
+            window_data.start < reservation.end
+            and reservation.start < window_data.end
+        ):
+            raise ConflictError(
+                f"maintenance window overlaps active reservation {reservation.id}"
+            )
+
+    # Create and store the new window
+    window = MaintenanceWindow(
+        id=store.maintenance_windows.allocate_id(),
+        item_id=item_id,
+        **window_data.model_dump(),
+    )
+    store.maintenance_windows.insert(window)
+    return window
+
+
+def list_windows(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """List all maintenance windows for an item, ordered by start date."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    return store.maintenance_windows.for_item(item_id)

-
-An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and

-  (`limit` 1..100, default 20; `offset` >= 0, default 0). `total` is the number of
-  matching items before pagination.

-`tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.

-`status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.

-- `start` may not be in the past (today is allowed).

+ 79|   affect availability.
+ 80| - Only `active` reservations can be cancelled or returned.
+ 81| 
+ 82| `GET /availability?item_id&start&end` answers whether a reservation for that range would be
+ 83| accepted, with a reason and the ids of the conflicting reservations.
+ 84| 
+ 85| ### Pricing
+ 86| 
+ 87| - `days = end - start`. One day is free for every **full** 7 days:
+ 88|   `billable_days = days - days // 7` (7 days -> 6 billable, 14 -> 12).
+ 89| - Rental amount = `daily_rate * billable_days`.
+ 90| - Tier discount: regular 0%, silver 5%, gold 15%.
+ 91| - Coupons (`POST /coupons`): an upper-case alphanumeric code with a percent off (1..100).
+ 92| - Tier and coupon discounts **add up** (silver 5% + 10% coupon = 15%) and the combined
+ 93|   discount is **capped at 30%** (gold 15% + 20% coupon = 30%, not 35%).
+ 94| - Discounts apply **only to the rental amount** and are applied **before tax**.
+ 95| - Tax is 20% of the discounted subtotal.
+ 96| 
+ 97| ### Returns
+ 98| 
+ 99| `POST /reservations/{id}/return` with optional `returned_on` (defaults to today) and
+100| `damaged` flag.
+101| 
+102| - `returned_on` cannot be before `start` or after today.
+103| - `late_days = max(0, returned_on - end)`. Returning on the `end` date (or earlier) is on
+104|   time: 0 late days. Returning on `end + 1` is 1 late day.
+105| - Late fee = `daily_rate * 1.5 * late_days`.
+106| - Damaged: the whole deposit is withheld and the item goes to `maintenance`. Otherwise the
+107|   deposit is refunded in full.
+108| - Early returns are not refunded: the rental is charged for the booked range.
+109| 
+110| ### Invoices
+111| 
+112| `GET /reservations/{id}/invoice` (active or returned reservations; cancelled ones have no
+113| invoice, 409).
+114| 
+115| - Lines: a `rental` line (quantity = billable days) and, for late returns, a `late_fee`
+116|   line (quantity = late days).
+117| - `subtotal` = sum of line amounts.
+118| - `discount` = rental line amount * combined discount rate (tier + coupon, capped at 30%).
+119| - `tax` = 20% of `subtotal - discount`.
+120| - `total` = `subtotal - discount + tax`.
+121| - Money is a decimal, rounded to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP only when a figure is produced
+122|   (each line amount, discount, tax, total) - never on intermediate rates.
